question: What carriers do we work with?
agent_answer:
We work with 3 carriers (TMS):

| ID | Name | Type | Cost/kg | Transit |
|----|------|------|---------|---------|
| CAR-001 | Kerry Express | Ground | ฿15 | 2 days |
| CAR-002 | SCG Cold Chain | Refrigerated | ฿25 | 1 day |
| CAR-003 | Flash Express Premium | Refrigerated | ฿35 | 1 day |

Two refrigerated carriers (required for fresh mangoes) and one ground carrier for ambient/processed products. Flash Express is the most expensive but matches SCG on transit time.
